Getty Images **Morgan Wallen**breaks his own record this week by charting a historic 37 songs on the Billboard Hot 100 simultaneously, propelled by his new album,*I’m the Problem*. Wallen previously set the all-time record for most titles on the Hot 100 in a single week with 36, which was set on March 18, 2023, and powered by his album*One Thing at a Time*. The 37-song record includes 36 tracks –including 29 chart debuts –from Wallen’s new album, which also premiered at No. 1 on the Billboard 200. The lone entry on the chart not from the country superstar’s new project is**Post Malone**’s “I Had Some Help,” which features Wallen, and ranks at No. 19 in its 54th week on the chart, which includes six weeks spent at No. 1.
